app.name: Digital Bridge onboarding

consent.smsResume: Send me a text message (SMS) link so I can continue another day

edit.saveReturn: Save and return to my profile

employer.adjustment.captions.explanation: Free in Google Meet, Teams, and Zoom; makes team calls accessible immediately.
employer.adjustment.captions.title: Live captions in meetings
employer.adjustment.flexible.explanation: Free; reduces transport barriers and supports medical or mobility schedules.
employer.adjustment.flexible.title: Flexible hours / remote option
employer.adjustment.instructions.explana: Free; helps Deaf, hard-of-hearing, and neurodivergent staff work independently.

employer.adjustment.quiet.title: Quiet workspace or noise-cancelling headphones

employer.intro: Tell candidates which support your workplace offers. Candidates never tell you what they filtered by.
employer.suggestionsIntro: Add a practical adjustment to this job with one click.
employer.title: Post a job with workplace support
errors.summaryIntro: Fix the following to continue. Select an item to go to that question.

fidel.label: Type the sounds with English letters
field.agentId: Name of the staff member helping you
field.coverNote: Why do you want this job?
field.coverNote.hint: A few sentences are enough. You can answer by voice.
field.description.hint: What will the person do? Use short, plain sentences.
field.docReference.hint: If the paper has a number, type it here.
field.otherText: Tell us in your own words
field.otherText.hint: For example: I prefer a seat near the door.
field.referenceNumber.hint: Type it as it appears on the card. You can say it by voice.
field.remoteJob: This job can be done from home
field.resumeCode.hint: The code from your text message, for example DB-4F7K2Q
field.route: Way to confirm who you are
field.viaPartner: I share a phone — contact me through my partner organisation
filter.count: Showing {count} jobs matching your support preferences
filter.none: No jobs offer all of these yet. Try removing one choice.
filter.private: Employers never see what you select here.
guide.choices: This step has choices instead of text fields. Say the item number of your choice.
guide.confirm: You said: {text}. Say yes to keep it, or no to try again.
guide.done: All fields on this step are done. Say next to continue.
guide.field: Item {n}: {label}. Speak your answer after the sound.
guide.noteReady: Your voice note is ready. Say yes to keep it, or no to record again.
guide.nothing: Nothing was heard. Say no to try again, or skip for the next field.
guide.start: Guided fill. I will take you through the fields on this step one by one.
help.blindTitle: Using this form without seeing the screen
help.dialogBody1: You can stop at any time. Your answers stay saved on this device, and there is no time limit.
help.dialogBody2: Use the microphone button next to a question to answer by voice. You can always check and change what we heard.
help.dialogBody3: Turn on "Simple words" for shorter instructions, or "Read aloud" to hear the question.
help.dialogBody4: A staff member from a partner organisation (for example AAAPD or Tomorrow is Better) can sit with you and help. You decide every answer.
help.guide.numbers: Then say the number shown next to an item to choose it. You can also say next, back, repeat, help or stop.
help.guide.tab: Press {tab} to move to the next item. Press {shiftTab} to go back.
help.guide.voice: Press {altV} to turn on voice control.
help.noTts: Read aloud is not available in this browser. Please read the text on the screen.
help.noVoice: This device has no voice for this language. Please read the text on the screen.
help.signBody: You can ask for an Ethiopian Sign Language interpreter or captions. This choice is private, like your other support choices.
help.signSaved: Saved. You can change this on the support question.
help.signToggle: I would like an Ethiopian Sign Language interpreter or captions
id.community_document: School certificate, birth record or community letter
id.community_document.hint: Any official paper with your name on it.
id.national_id_or_passport: National ID, Kebele ID or passport
id.national_id_or_passport.hint: Type the number on your card.
id.partner_voucher: Refer me through a partner organisation
id.partner_voucher.hint: A partner organisation you know confirms who you are. No document needed.
id.refugee_id.hint: Type the number on your refugee or returnee card.
need.screen_reader_materials: Screen reader support (materials that work with a screen reader)
need.sign_language_captions: Captions or an Ethiopian Sign Language interpreter
need.written_not_phone: Written messages instead of phone calls
note.denied: The microphone is blocked, so we could not record. You can type your answer instead.
note.error: Recording stopped. You can try again or type your answer.
note.kept: Voice note kept for {field}. You can also type the answer, but you do not have to.
note.record: Record a voice note for {field} instead
note.recorded: Recording stopped. Listen to it, then choose Keep voice note.
note.recording: Recording. Speak now, then press Stop recording. You have up to 1 minute.
note.tooBig: This voice note is too big to save on this device. Record a shorter one or type your answer.
partner.consent: I agree that this organisation can confirm who I am to Digital Bridge
partner.request: Ask the partner to confirm me
privacy.body: You control your data. You can download a copy or delete it at any time. Your support choices are kept separate and are never shown to employers unless you say so.
privacy.confirm: Are you sure? This removes all your answers from this device and from Digital Bridge. This cannot be undone.
privacy.exportReady: Your data file is ready. A copy is shown below.
privacy.title: Your data
readAloud.visualNote: This device has no voice for this language, so we show the words one phrase at a time with a soft sound.
review.finishedBody: Thank you. Your profile is ready. You can now look for jobs in the Career Gateway.
review.name: Name
review.voiceNote: Voice note kept (we will listen to it)
script.closing: Say an item number to choose it, say answer to fill a field, or say guide to fill the fields one by one.
sign.cameraBlocked: The camera is not available or is blocked. You can still build your answer with the cards below.
sign.cameraOn: Camera on. Show your signs inside the picture.
sign.cardsHint: Choose numbers, letters or words one at a time. Pictures of the Ethiopian Sign Language hand shapes will be added with our Deaf co-designers.
sign.honest: This tool does not read signs by itself. You can also build your answer from the cards below.
sign.intro: Record a short video of your answer in Ethiopian Sign Language. A person who knows Ethiopian Sign Language will read it, and you can continue without typing.
sign.kept: Sign language video kept for {field}. You can continue without typing.
sign.recorded: Recording stopped. Watch it, then choose Keep video.
sign.recording: Recording. Sign your answer, then press Stop recording. You have up to 20 seconds.
sign.title: Sign language answer
sign.waveHint: Turn on the camera, then wave on your left side to go back, on your right side to go forward, and in the middle to choose the highlighted card.
sms.body: We can send you a text message with a link. It works one time, for 24 hours.
sms.devLink: Test link (shown because SMS is simulated in this demo):
sms.heading: Continue later by SMS
sms.needPhone: Enter a valid phone number first, so we can text you.
sms.restored: Your answers are back. You can continue.
sms.restoreHeading: Do you have a resume code?
sms.sent: We sent a resume link to {phone}. It works one time, for 24 hours. Your code is {code}.
status.backOnline: You are online again. Your answers are being sent.
status.offlineSaved: Saved on this phone. It will send when you are online.
step0.hint: This takes about 10 minutes. Here is how it works.
step0.hint.simple: We ask a few questions. Take your time.
step0.point2: There is no time limit. Nothing is deleted if you stop.
step0.point3: Your answers are saved on this device as you type.
step0.point4: You can answer every question by voice, and check it before it is used.
step0.title: Welcome — before we start
step1.hint: Write your name the way you want employers to see it.
step1.title: What is your name?
step2.hint: We use this only to send you updates about your learning and jobs.
step2.title: How can we contact you?
step3.hint: Choose the calendar you know best. We change it for you.
step3.title: When were you born?
step4.hint: Choose any one way. You do not need a Kebele ID or a passport.
step4.hint.simple: Choose one way to show who you are.
step4.title: How can we confirm who you are?
step5.hint: Choose anything that helps you. You can skip this question.
step5.hint.simple: What helps you? You can skip.
step5.title: What support helps you learn and work best?
step6.hint: Check everything is right. Choose "Edit" to change an answer.
step6.title: Check your answers
support.choiceCleared: Prefer not to say is no longer selected.
support.noProof: No medical proof required. This stays private and is never shared without your permission.
support.preferNotToSay: Prefer not to say. I do not want to ask for support now.
support.preferNotToSay.chosen: Prefer not to say chosen. No support will be requested. You can change this at any time.
support.tellProvider: Share these choices with my learning provider so they can prepare
sync.offlineCount: Offline — {count} saved answers on this device. Will sync when back online.
sync.synced: All saved answers synced to server.
sync.syncing: Back online — syncing {current} of {total} saved answers...
vc.cmd.answer: answer: answer the current field by voice
vc.cmd.back: back: go to the previous question
vc.cmd.choose: choose: press, tick or open the current item
vc.cmd.guide: guide: fill in the fields one by one
vc.cmd.keys: In a noisy room, press the number keys instead.
vc.cmd.move: down or up: move to the next or previous item
vc.cmd.next: next: save and go to the next question
vc.cmd.numbers: a number, or item and a number: jump to that numbered item
vc.cmd.scroll: scroll down or scroll up: move the page
vc.cmd.stop: help: open Need help. commands: hear these commands. stop: turn voice control off
vc.cmd.switch: jobs or sign up: move voice control between the Career Gateway and onboarding
vc.denied: The microphone is blocked, so voice control cannot listen. Allow the microphone and try again.
vc.englishFallback: Amharic voice commands are not available on this device. Say the commands in English: next, back, repeat, down, up, choose, answer, help, stop.
vc.hint: Move through this form by speaking. Keyboard shortcut:
vc.insecure: Voice needs a secure page address that starts with https. Open the https address, or type your answer.
vc.list: list, say choose to change it
vc.movedCareer: Onboarding complete. Voice control moved to the Career Gateway.
vc.noBack: This is the first question. There is nothing to go back to.
vc.noField: Move to a field first: say down until you hear a text box, then say answer.
vc.noNext: There is no Continue button here.
vc.noNumber: There is no item number {n} here.
vc.noOther: There is no {widget} on this page.
vc.on: Voice control is on. Say a number to choose an item, or say next, back, repeat, down, up, choose, answer, help or stop.
vc.paused: Voice navigation paused while you record your answer. It starts again when you finish.
vc.start: Say down to move to the first item.
vc.state.paused: Paused while you record your answer
vc.state.processing: Processing your voice (about 1 second, please wait)
vc.state.speaking: Speaking. I will listen again when I finish.
vc.unknown: Sorry, I did not understand {text}. Say help to hear the commands.
vc.unsupported: Voice control needs speech recognition, which this browser does not have. You can use Tab, Enter and Space, or a screen reader.
vision.label: Colours
voice.amFallback: Browser speech-to-text for Amharic is not available on this device, so we are recording your voice note directly instead. Speak now and press Stop recording when you finish.
voice.amFallbackType: Browser speech-to-text for Amharic is not available on this device. Please type your answer. The helper below can turn English letters into Amharic letters.
voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. You can type your answer instead.
voice.error: Voice input stopped. You can type your answer instead.
voice.nothing: We did not hear anything. Try again or type your answer.
voice.readBackUnavailable: Read back is not available in this browser or language. The text is shown above so you can check it.
voice.reviewLabel: Review what we heard (you can edit this)
voice.unsupported: Voice input is not available in this browser. You can type, or use the microphone on your phone keyboard.
voice.used: Answer added. You can still change it.
wizard.saved: Your answer is saved on this device.
